reviewer: Codex default model; direct visual review in this session, no delegated or external-model scoring
scope: All 107 entries in supplied catalog; group metadata absent, so no category exclusions
selection_stage: Source-motion candidates for subsequent retarget review, not final animation approvals
method: Eight evenly spaced frame indices including endpoints per GIF, inspected directly; supplementary 16-frame sheets for 12 clips. GIF durations are preview timings, not certified source timing.

stalk_walk.name: Monster_Walk
stalk_walk.reason: Compact forward gait, low arms and little flourish; best stalking base, needs sword hand pose.

stalk_walk.name: Proud_Strut
stalk_walk.reason: Broad upright forward steps and restrained low arms; second stalking base, soften swagger and author grip.

x_combo.name: Weapon_Combo_2
x_combo.reason: Alternating raised right-hand windups and descending cross-body cuts with steps; strongest X-combo base, needs blade-path confirmation.

horizontal_sweep.name: Charged_Slash
horizontal_sweep.reason: Compact planted waist/chest-level cross-body swing with torso follow-through; best horizontal-sweep base, weapon absent.

overhead.name: Attack
overhead.reason: Two-handed overhead lift followed by committed downward strike and planted recovery; strong overhead candidate.

overhead.name: Heavy_Hammer_Swing
overhead.reason: Grounded high two-arm windup and deep committed downward strike; second overhead base, hammer grip needs sword adaptation.

stagger.name: Hit_Reaction_1
stagger.reason: Small planted torso compression and recovery; best restrained stagger, needs armed hand pose.

stagger.name: Hit_Reaction_to_Waist
stagger.reason: Clear weighty waist recoil with feet supporting and controlled return; second stagger, adapt boxing arms.

death.name: Dead
death.reason: Knees buckle from armed stance into prone collapse; best death source, raw preview contains no aerial tumble.

death.name: Fall_Dead_from_Abdominal_Injury
death.reason: Clutches abdomen, sinks to knees and folds onto side; convincing collapse, adapt occupied sword hand.

dodge.name: Stand_Dodge_1
dodge.reason: Single bent-knee evasive step with balanced recovery; best dodge base, replace boxing hands with sword carriage.

dodge.name: Stand_Dodge
dodge.reason: Compact standing torso slip with low arms and return; second dodge candidate, does not establish an offline step.

empty_role_reasons.idle_low_hang: No preview establishes the specified active sword grip hanging low at the side with point toward ground; Combat_Stance is a crouched shield guard.
empty_role_reasons.jump_lunge: No clip shows a clear gap-closing jump whose landing is a thrust followed by overshoot continuation.
empty_role_reasons.rising_spin: No candidate establishes both a rising sword arc and controlled rotation at no more than roughly one revolution per second; roll/spin names are unsafe substitutes.
empty_role_reasons.the_pause: No complete clip combines low-sword stillness with a sudden offline step; boxing counters and alert pivots do not meet this role.
